visualCharacteristics.purpose: Thin strip of two linked promo images at the top of the homepage
visualCharacteristics.description: Two-cell strip of linked image banners with a vertical divider between them; stacks with a bottom divider on mobile.

contentPattern.description: Two linked promo banners side by side (Tax Free + Free Shipping with Military Star; Authorized Patron Information), separated by a vertical divider

usage: Thin strip of two linked promo images at the top of the homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for a pair of side-by-side linked banners separated by a divider. For more than two, or for repeating tiles, use a cards-promo-* block.
